Syndra.name: Sphere stun
Syndra.use: Basic lane stun: sphere on target then knock it through

Syndra.name: Short trade
Syndra.use: Cheap lane poke, throw the fresh sphere back for slow
Syndra.notes: 2 sources; W step = grab and throw as one step (metabot continues into E and autos)

Syndra.name: Full combo
Syndra.use: Kill combo at 6 on a single priority target
Syndra.notes: 2 sources; lolstats orders it W > Q > E > R. W step = grab and throw as one step

Syndra.name: Teamfight stun
Syndra.use: Ult frontline, then E the leftover spheres for AoE stun

Syndra.name: Max damage (2 Q charges)
Syndra.use: All-in from level 9 (40 Splinters of Wrath: Dark Sphere holds 2 charges): throw the first sphere with W, second Q, E pushes both spheres (stun), R takes both (5 spheres), third Q when a charge recharges
Syndra.notes: user (Syndra main) + wiki Dark Sphere (Transcendent: 2 charges at 40 Splinters, 7 s recharge, 1.25 s between casts). perform() waits for the sphere before W and for the thrown/pushed spheres to land before R (wiki Syndra_R: held or pushed spheres aren't taken); the third Q comes when the first charge is back (5.4 s at 11 with Luden's)

Viktor.name: Level 1 trade
Viktor.use: Early lane trade using Q shield and empowered auto

Viktor.name: Short trade
Viktor.use: Standard lane trade once E is unlocked
Viktor.notes: 2 sources; metabot adds a trailing AA

Viktor.name: Catch
Viktor.use: Teamfight lockdown: field behind target, then ray and storm
Viktor.notes: 2 sources; approx: W placement behind target not represented

Gwen.name: Short trade
Gwen.use: Lane trade: dash in, center snip, auto, walk out
Gwen.notes: 2 sources; Q is stacked by prior autos (lolstats pre-stacks on minions) - approx: Q stack count not represented; 1v9 variant E > AA > Q > AA

Gwen.name: Extended all-in
Gwen.use: Full fight: weave autos between each Needlework cast
Gwen.notes: 2 sources (dignitas lists the R > AA > R > AA > R part)

Gwen.name: Needlework weave
Gwen.use: Ult rotation unlocking all three waves

DrMundo.name: Short trade
DrMundo.use: Slow with cleaver, auto, then empowered E hit
DrMundo.notes: 2 sources; lolstats extends with W then W recast. The AA after E is added: Blunt Force Trauma empowers his next attack (wiki), which the guides leave implicit (combo audit 2026-09-24)

DrMundo.name: All-in
DrMundo.use: Level 6+ fight: ult early, run them down
DrMundo.notes: 2 sources; lolstats orders Q > R > W > E without AA. The AA after E is added: E only empowers the next attack (combo audit 2026-09-24)

Kaisa.name: Quick trade
Kaisa.use: Short lane trade weaving Q between autos

Kaisa.name: W poke
Kaisa.use: Long-range W tag, then follow with auto and Q

Kaisa.name: Ult all-in
Kaisa.use: Tag with W, ult onto marked target, burst
Kaisa.notes: 2 sources; 1v9 writes W > R > AA > Q > AA

Kaisa.name: Stealth dive
Kaisa.use: Evolved E invisibility into ult and Q burst
Kaisa.notes: 2 sources; approx: requires evolved E (invisibility) and R needs a plasma-marked target; 1v9 adds W during E and an AA before Q. W during E is taken from 1v9: Killer Instinct needs a champion affected by Plasma in the last 4 s (wiki Kaisa_R), so E > R > Q alone can't cast R (combo audit 2026-09-24)

Smolder.name: Short trade
Smolder.use: Early lane poke; W slows if they fight back
Smolder.notes: 2 sources; leaguecoachmerch opens with an extra AA

Smolder.name: Ult opener
Smolder.use: Teamfight: ult the clump, then W and Q
Smolder.notes: 2 sources, loose agreement: leaguecoachmerch writes R > AA > Q then W/E as available. 1v9 Smolder page rejected (wrong ability names)

Ezreal.name: Poke
Ezreal.use: Tag with W, detonate with Q

Ezreal.name: All-in
Ezreal.use: Committed trade blinking in for extra burst

Ezreal.name: Full combo
Ezreal.use: All-in finished with ult for the kill
Ezreal.notes: 2 sources; metabot orders W > Q > E > AA > R

Katarina.name: Classic burst
Katarina.use: Standard kill combo once Q dagger is thrown near the target
Katarina.notes: 3 sources (1v9 inserts an AA between W and R). approx: dagger pickups are implicit in the E/W steps

Katarina.name: All-in
Katarina.use: Kill combo: blink in, W, Q to cut escape, then Lotus
Katarina.notes: 2 sources (leaguecoachmerch adds an E to the Q dagger, i.e. E then P, before R)

Katarina.name: W into Lotus
Katarina.use: Fastest burst: Preparation right before Death Lotus
Katarina.notes: 2 sources (the wiki gives W right before R; leaguecoachmerch E>W>R then E to the W dagger)

Katarina.name: Electrocute trade
Katarina.use: Three separate hits for Electrocute: blade, Shunpo, dagger pickup
Katarina.notes: 1 source: wiki. P = picking up the Q dagger (Sinister Steel); approx: the dagger landing where she Shunpos is assumed

Yone.name: Spirit poke
Yone.use: Low-risk lane trade, snapping back to safety
Yone.notes: 2 sources; lolstats specifies the Q as Q3 (stacked), 1v9 does not. Final E is the spirit-form return

Yone.name: Q3 all-in
Yone.use: Full commit with Q3 stacked, knockup guarantees the ult
Yone.notes: 2 sources (lolstats lists Q3>E>R>W>Q without autos). First Q is the stacked Q3 dash/knockup Opens with 2 Gathering Storm stacks (start.stacks), so the first Q is Q3.

Yone.name: Flash Q3 ult
Yone.use: Surprise pick; flash mid Q3 dash then guaranteed ult
Yone.notes: 4 sources (1v9 continues W>AA; lolmatchups lists only Q3+Flash). Q is Q3. approx: flash-buffered dash redirection not modeled. Opens with 2 Gathering Storm stacks (start.stacks), so the first Q is Q3.

Samira.name: Extended trade
Samira.use: Dash in, burst, then spin to block return fire

Samira.name: Fast S-rank
Samira.use: Build style to S quickly and ult in extended fights
Samira.notes: 2 sources (lolstats omits the AA between E and W; leaguefeed has a close variant AA>Q>E>AA>W>AA>R)

Samira.name: Whirl stack
Samira.use: Instant all-in: E+Q during W spin to reach ult fast
Samira.notes: 2 sources. approx: guides write W2 for the second slash of the same W cast; it is not a recast so it is dropped. E+Q are cast during the W spin (animation overlap not modeled). engine: this sequence reaches 5 of the 6 Style grades, so R is skipped unless Style was built before

Zed.name: WEQ poke
Zed.use: Bread-and-butter lane harass with shadow doubling damage
Zed.notes: 3 sources (1v9 also lists W>Q>E as a poke variant)

Zed.name: Triple shuriken
Zed.use: Max burst: all three shurikens on the marked target
Zed.notes: 2 sources (fragster gives R>W>Q only; 1v9 ends with an unspecified 'return', modeled as R swap-back)

Zed.name: Safe shadow all-in
Zed.use: Pre-place escape shadow, ult, burst, swap back
Zed.notes: 2 sources (wiki describes placing W before R for the escape but gives no E/Q order). Final R is the swap back to the R shadow

Akali.name: Q poke
Akali.use: Lane harass: Q then empowered passive auto
Akali.notes: 2 sources (lolmatchups follows with a second Q; lolstats follows with W to hide). The AA is the passive-empowered auto after leaving the ring; passive ring positioning not modeled

Akali.name: Full all-in
Akali.use: Kill combo when R1 lands; R2 executes low target
Akali.notes: 2 sources (wiki gives only R1 first, Q during/before R2; lolmatchups has a longer Q>AA>R>AA>Q>E>E>AA>Q>R version)

Akali.name: Flash R engage
Akali.use: Surprise engage outside expected R range
Akali.notes: 2 sources (wiki says Ult + Flash without fixing the order)

Yasuo.name: EQ trade
Yasuo.use: Dash in to Q the enemy, dash back out on a minion
Yasuo.notes: 2 sources. approx: E targets are minion then enemy then minion; minion targets not modeled. Second E is a new cast on another unit, not a recast. The exit E onto a minion is dropped: it deals no champion damage, and Sweeping Blade can't re-target the champion for 10-6 s (wiki), so perform() cast it on the champion 8 s later (combo audit 2026-09-24)

Yasuo.name: Beyblade
Yasuo.use: Unreactable circular Q3 knockup at 2 Q stacks
Yasuo.notes: 2 sources. Q is the stacked Q3 (E-Q circle). approx: flash-buffered ring relocation not modeled. Opens with 2 Gathering Storm stacks (start.stacks), so the first Q is Q3.

Yasuo.name: Airblade
Yasuo.use: After a knockup, EQ a nearby unit and ult mid-cast
Yasuo.notes: 3 sources (vocal.media prefixes a Q3 knockup). approx: R cast during the EQ animation (cancel) not modeled. Opens with 2 Gathering Storm stacks (start.stacks), so the first Q is Q3.

Yasuo.name: Keyblade
Yasuo.notes: 3 sources (dignitas omits the AA and adds a trailing Q). First Q is Q3; second E needs a different target. Opens with 2 Gathering Storm stacks (start.stacks), so the first Q is Q3.

Yasuo.name: Delayed ult
Yasuo.use: Weave an auto before ulting a Q3-knocked target
Yasuo.notes: 1 source: wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com). Q is Q3 tornado. Opens with 2 Gathering Storm stacks (start.stacks), so the first Q is Q3.

LeeSin.name: Kick chase
LeeSin.use: Mark with Q, kick, then follow the knocked target with Q2.
LeeSin.notes: 2 sources (the wiki gives only the Q-before-R-then-Q2 order, steemit adds the E). E1 only, no E2 in this version.

LeeSin.name: Kick flash
LeeSin.use: Dash in, then redirect the kick with a buffered Flash.
LeeSin.notes: 2 sources (fragster lists only the R > Flash core). approx: the Flash sets the kick direction, which the engine does not model.

LeeSin.name: Flash insec
LeeSin.use: Flash behind a Q-marked target to kick them into your team.
LeeSin.notes: 2 sources (keengamer's 'Chinese insec' also has a ward hop after Flash, which is dropped here). approx: the flash-behind positioning is not represented.

LeeSin.name: Ward-hop insec
LeeSin.use: Standard insec when Flash is down and a ward is available.
LeeSin.notes: 2 sources. approx: the ward placement is dropped; W here is the dash to the ward behind the target.

Jayce.name: Gate poke
Jayce.use: Long-range lane poke with the gate speeding up Q.
Jayce.notes: 3 sources. Both steps in Cannon form (Shock Blast, then Acceleration Gate in its path).

Jayce.name: Cannon-to-hammer burst
Jayce.use: Poke, then swap to hammer and all-in a damaged target.
Jayce.notes: 2 sources (dodge.gg adds one more AA at the end). Forms: Q,E = Cannon (Shock Blast, Gate), R = swap to Hammer, then Q,W,E = Hammer (To the Skies!, Lightning Field, Thundering Blow). approx: the engine does not model the form swap.

Jayce.name: Hammer finish
Jayce.use: Melee finish on a low target, ending with the knockback.
Jayce.notes: 2 sources (this is the opening of 1v9's all-in). All steps in Hammer form (To the Skies!, Lightning Field, AA, Thundering Blow).

Tristana.name: Jump all-in
Tristana.use: Jump in, then stack the charge quickly with Rapid Fire.
Tristana.notes: 2 sources (the W > E > Q order is in both; the AA placement follows 1v9, and dodge.gg adds a W reset at the end).

Tristana.name: Charge detonate
Tristana.use: Jump onto a three-stack charge to finish or reset W.
Tristana.notes: 1 source: wiki. The W completes the charge stacks.

Tristana.name: Jump-over kick
Tristana.use: Jump past the target and knock them toward allies.
Tristana.notes: 2 sources (the wiki describes jumping over and then R, without the E). approx: the knockback direction and positioning are not represented.

Tristana.name: Flash insec
Tristana.use: Flash and jump behind to kick a carry into your team.
Tristana.notes: 2 sources (facecheck gives the exact sequence; the wiki gives the jump-over-and-R idea). The second W is a new cast after a reset, not a recast. approx: the positioning behind the target is not represented.. A third AA is added before the second W: the reset needs Explosive Charge detonated at 4 stacks (wiki Tristana_W), and R + 2 AA give only 3 (combo audit 2026-09-24)

Qiyana.name: Dash Q
Qiyana.use: Fire Q from the dash so it is hard to dodge.
Qiyana.notes: 2 sources (facecheck opens its combo with E > Q).

Qiyana.name: Assassination
Qiyana.use: Full one-shot on a squishy near a wall.
Qiyana.notes: 2 sources (facecheck gives this exact order; dodge.gg's full rotation uses the same abilities but opens with W, Flash and R before E > Q > W > Q). approx: the R wall stun and W element pickup (terrain) are not represented. The first Q is ice, the second uses the element from W.

Jhin.name: Poke
Jhin.use: Lane poke using a grenade bounce and the fourth-shot crit.
Jhin.notes: 2 sources (the wiki describes autos, then Q, then the last shot on a champion). approx: minion bounce targets are not represented.

Jhin.name: Full trade
Jhin.use: Mark with damage, root with W, then crit the rooted target.
Jhin.notes: 2 sources (dodge.gg lists Q > W > AA without the opening AA).

Jhin.name: Trap root
Jhin.use: Trap marks the target so W roots with no setup.
Jhin.notes: 2 sources (dodge.gg orders it E > W > AA). approx: the target stepping on the trap is assumed.

Camille.name: Short trade
Camille.use: Quick lane trade; wait for Q2 to charge for true damage.
Camille.notes: 2 sources (1v9 opens with E; dodge.gg opens with an AA on a minion). Q2 empowers the next auto, which the guides leave implicit. The AA after Q2 is added: Q2 only empowers the next attack, which the guides leave implicit.

Camille.name: Hook all-in
Camille.use: Engage off a wall with the stun, then finish with W.
Camille.notes: 2 sources (the exact order is 1v9's; dodge.gg has the E-opened Q1 > AA > Q2 core with R inserted). approx: E1 is the hook onto the wall and E2 the dash stun; the terrain is not represented. The AA after Q2 is added: Q2 only empowers the next attack, which the guides leave implicit.

Camille.name: Ult lock
Camille.use: Hook in, trap the carry with R, then burst.
Camille.notes: 2 sources (the order is dodge.gg's; 1v9's full burst casts R before E and adds W at the end). approx: the wall hook is not represented. The AA after Q2 is added: Q2 only empowers the next attack, which the guides leave implicit.

Sylas.name: Short trade
Sylas.use: Early lane trade once E is unlocked
Sylas.notes: 2 sources (1v9 full sequence; lolsensei level-2 trade E1>Q>E2>auto without W). E2 = Abduct recast. aussyelo gives a similar E>Q>AA>W without E2.

Sylas.name: All-in
Sylas.use: Full rotation weaving passive autos between spells
Sylas.notes: 2 sources agree on E1>E2 opener into W and Q; order and autos follow leaguecoachmerch (also its E2>W>Q burst). lolsensei casts Q before W: E1>E2>Q>W>AA.

Talon.name: Short trade
Talon.use: Standard lane trade to proc passive bleed
Talon.notes: 3 sources. W out-and-back is one cast (return pass is automatic, not a recast). wiki also lists the Q-first order as the more reliable variant.

Talon.name: Melee reset
Talon.use: Point-blank burst using Q's auto reset

Talon.name: Fast one-shot
Talon.use: Quickest kill combo on a squishy target
Talon.notes: 2 sources. approx: R is cast mid-Q lunge; the AA is Talon's automatic post-Q attack that procs passive.

Talon.name: Flash engage
Talon.use: Punish a dodged or out-of-range W
Talon.notes: 2 sources. aussyelo's level-2 version continues with W and Ignite.

Ahri.name: Charm combo
Ahri.use: Land charm, then guaranteed orb and fox-fire
Ahri.notes: 2 sources (1v9 as prefix of its all-in). wiki advises an auto before W so fox-fire targets the champion.

Ahri.name: All-in
Ahri.use: Finish a target when the basic combo falls short
Ahri.notes: 2 sources. wiki: cast R in place for its damage after E-Q-W.

Ahri.name: Dive
Ahri.use: Dash to backline, burst, dash out
Ahri.notes: 1v9 exact sequence; leaguecoachmerch and aussyelo describe the same R-in/charm/burst/R-out pattern (aussyelo adds Ignite, no E). Second R = R2.

Ahri.name: Flash charm
Ahri.notes: 2 sources. approx: Flash during E cast animation relocates the charm; follow-up damage not specified.

Fizz.name: Short trade
Fizz.use: Core lane trade using W's empowered auto
Fizz.notes: 2 sources (leaguecoachmerch as prefix of its gap-close combo).

Fizz.name: Gap-close all-in
Fizz.use: Commit without ult, E out to escape
Fizz.notes: 2 sources. E written once (Playful; Trickster recast not specified).

Fizz.name: Shark all-in
Fizz.use: Post-6 kill once shark is attached
Fizz.notes: 3 sources on R>Q>W; AA explicit only in leaguecoachmerch; wiki and leaguecoachmerch end with E, aussyelo stops at W. approx: wait for shark to land after R.

Riven.name: Fast Q
Riven.use: Level 1+ trade and core damage pattern
Riven.notes: 3 sources. approx: each AA animation-cancelled by Q/move click, not representable.

Riven.name: Shy combo
Riven.use: One-shot a backline target from range
Riven.notes: 2 sources. leaguecoachmerch inserts Hydra after AA (item unspecified). Second R = Wind Slash recast. Final Q assumed a Q3 not tracked as recast (sources don't say).

Riven.name: Hydra burst
Riven.use: Fastest burst on a squishy, no extra autos
Riven.notes: 1 source: wiki. approx: relies on animation cancels. Recasts: R2 at 5, Q2/Q3 at 6-7.

Riven.name: E-W engage
Riven.use: Instant stun hidden in shield dash

Irelia.name: Short trade
Irelia.use: Stun, dash in, trade, W to block return damage
Irelia.notes: 2 sources. Both write E once; expanded to E1+E2 (stun needs both), recast at 1.

Irelia.name: Stun dash
Irelia.use: Faster, hard-to-dodge stun during Q dash
Irelia.notes: 2 sources (aussyelo exact; leaguecoachmerch: E during Q animation). approx: E1 placed at own position.

Irelia.name: Teamfight dive
Irelia.use: Mark frontline, stun, chain resets to backline
Irelia.notes: 2 sources. 1v9 writes single E and adds W at end; aussyelo gives E1-E2. approx: Q resets on marked targets.
